newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dickson sees double-digit earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Dickson sees double-digit earnings growth.

text.p: Brandname goods wholesaler and retailer Dickson Concepts (International) Ltd said on Friday it was confident of double-digit earnings growth for the year ending March 31, 1997.

"Based on the group's results for the first half of the financial year, the group is confident that double digit profits and earnings growth will be maintained for the full year," Dickson executive director Edwin Ing said in a statement.

On Thursday, Dickson Concepts posted a sharp rise in interim profit to HK$833.09 million, including an exceptional gain of HK$643.56 million on partial disposal of shares in Harvey Nichols Group plc, from HK$169.18 million a year earlier.

The company said continued development of existing businesses, investment in Hong Kong Seibu, additional representations of established brands and the opening of more than 80 shops and outlets worldwide would ensure a stronger recurring income base for the group.
